items.headline: BILL Stock Could Swing $699 Million After Earnings
items.summary: Earnings focus on Wednesday, options market predicts volatile moves for retail investors. $ZIM reports Q2 results with 6.13% implied move, $BULL with 8.14%, and $IONC with 12.13% move.

items.headline: Estee Lauder, Moderna, Merck And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Wednesday
items.summary: Dow Jones up 200 points on Wed. Estee Lauder & other top stocks record gains after reporting strong Q4 results and positive sales guidance.
